nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name 'Dogecoin'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'DOGE'.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals (8).
Total token supply state variable, set once in the constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance; written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; written by approve and transferFrom.
Overflow-checked addition helper used to credit balances.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper used to debit balances and allowances.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper; declared but unused by Dogecoin.
Division helper with zero-divisor guard; declared but unused by Dogecoin.
Constructor initializing metadata, total supply and assigning all supply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked raw subtraction.
Returns the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Returns remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner from the allowed mapping.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no checks; state write performed by caller-controlled account.
Debits msg.sender and credits to using SafeMath, then emits Transfer.
Debits from, decreases spender allowance and credits to using SafeMath, then emits Transfer.
External caller-controlled address used as account key in constructor, approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Caller-triggered writes to balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] inside transfer before the event is emitted.
Caller-triggered writes to balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to] inside transferFrom.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] that bypasses SafeMath and can underflow.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read by the constructor and determines who receives the initial supply.
Constructor assigns the literal name to the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the literal symbol to the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the literal decimals value to the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes the fixed initial value into _totalSupply.
Constructor writes _totalSupply into balances[msg.sender].
approve uses msg.sender as the owner key when writing the allowance mapping.
approve writes tokens into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer debits the caller by indexing balances with msg.sender.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key for the allowance lookup and decrement.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transfer passes balances[msg.sender] and tokens to safeSub.
transfer passes balances[to] and tokens to safeAdd.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice for the balance and the allowance.
transferFrom credits the recipient via safeAdd.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in its return expression.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried owner.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for owner and spender.
Attacker-controlled msg.sender drives the transfer balance state writes and the subsequent Transfer event, the classic reentrancy-sensitive ordering pattern.
Attacker-controlled msg.sender drives the transferFrom balance and allowance state writes before the Transfer event.

Parameter b flows into safeAdd.
Local return variable c is written by safeAdd.
Parameter a flows into safeSub.
Parameter b flows into safeSub.
Local return variable c is written by safeSub.

tokenOwner parameter is used to index balances in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter is written into the allowed mapping in approve.
to parameter is used as the credit key in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transfer.
from parameter is the debited account key in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credit key in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved and deducted from allowance in transferFrom.
transfer executes the caller-triggered balance state writes represented by this unsafe operation.
transferFrom executes the balance and allowance state writes represented by this unsafe operation.
totalSupply executes the raw unchecked subtraction that can underflow the returned supply.
